That 21% line is exactly what it means: the P2 ships from our US warehouse, so the $379 is the unit price only, and 21% import VAT plus any duty is charged on delivery by the carrier or customs. We don't collect it at checkout and I can't quote the exact figure your customs office will raise. Shipping cost is separate and does show at checkout once you enter your address.
